subject: MAP kickoff: Sprint Zero & success metrics for Nexera Health pilot
messages:
From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@nexerahealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: MAP kickoff: Sprint Zero & success metrics for Nexera pilot

Hi Daniel —

Thanks again for making time yesterday. Per our conversation I wanted to kick off a short mutual action plan (MAP) to align goals, owners, and a 6-week evaluation runway for the pilot. High level asks below — please confirm or flag changes and I will update the live MAP and send an invite for Sprint Zero.

Primary objectives (proposed):
- Validate retrieval + context-window accuracy on Nexera clinical search workflows (target: 90th percentile precision >= 0.82)
- End-to-end latency below 350ms p50 for search queries in the pilot environment
- Qualitative pass for regulatory handling and data lineage for a sample of 1,000 records

Proposed timeline (starting next week):
- Week 0 (Sprint Zero): environment access, data sampling, evaluation criteria sign-off
- Weeks 1–4: run eval workloads + weekly checkpoints
- Weeks 5–6: consolidation, handoff notes, ROI snapshot and next-steps discussion

Owners (please confirm):
- Nexera champion: Daniel Park (you) — evaluation priorities + sample data handoff
- Redwood AE/PM: Avery Johnson — MAP owner and delivery coordinator
- Redwood CS Lead: Marissa Cole — success criteria, onboarding, and quality checks
- Redwood Solutions: Karthik Iyer — integration/infra and test harness

Attachments: I attached: Nexera_MAP_Template.xlsx (MAP template) and Nexera_Sprint0_agenda.pdf (Sprint Zero agenda). I can also drop our SOC 2 front-page now and full report after an NDA if helpful.

Next actions: can you confirm the champion and two technical reviewers (name + email) and whether the 6-week cadence works for you? If yes I’ll: 1) update the MAP, 2) send a calendar invite for Sprint Zero (30–45 min), and 3) add the HubSpot deal + Drive folder links.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Avery Johnson
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
avery.johnson@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

----

From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@nexerahealth.com>

Cc: Sara Lim <sara.lim@nexerahealth.com>, Marcus Holden <marcus.holden@nexerahealth.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 15:09:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: Sprint Zero & success metrics for Nexera pilot

Thanks Avery — this looks good and appreciated for the clear framing. Quick answers from our side: 

- I will be the champion and own the evaluation deliverables.
- Technical reviewers: Sara Lim (CTO) — sara.lim@nexerahealth.com, and Marcus Holden (Head of Data) — marcus.holden@nexerahealth.com. They’ll be on the initial call and a couple of weekly checkpoints.
- Timeline: we prefer a 7-week window if possible (one extra week for compliance checks). Can you shift the final consolidation to Week 7?
- Security: we will need the SOC 2 report and a short security questionnaire filled (I can share the questionnaire by EOD).

On a practical note: for Sprint Zero please list the minimal access needed (S3 read-only sample, API key for test environment, and a small sample dataset ~1k records). We will aim to provision access by Monday.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@nexerahealth.com>, Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: Sprint Zero & success metrics for Nexera pilot

Hi Daniel — very glad to meet you (virtually). Welcome.

Thanks for confirming the reviewers and the request for an extra week — 7 weeks is fine and we’ll treat Week 7 as an extended consolidation/compliance verification period. I’ll own the success-criteria checkpoints and will schedule weekly 30-minute syncs with your team so we can keep the technical details light on the AE side.

Action items I’ll take on now: 
- Upload our SOC 2 front-page to the Drive folder and share the secure link (full report on NDA).
- Create a populated MAP example (MAP-Filled-Example.xlsx) with the objectives we discussed; I’ll attach that to the Drive folder.
- Draft a minimal access checklist (S3 read-only sample, API key + rate limit guidance, anonymization checklist for the 1k sample).

Daniel — could you confirm who on your side will own provisioning (infra contact) so Karthik can coordinate the access request? Also, if you have any specific evaluation prompts or user flows you want us to prioritize, please paste them in the Drive doc and we’ll incorporate them into the test harness.

I will also add a HubSpot link to the MAP and share the Sprint Zero calendar invite once Avery confirms the meeting window.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Great — thanks everyone. I scheduled Sprint Zero for Monday, May 24 at 10:30 AM PT (30 minutes). Calendar invite and drive folder link are live: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abcd1234 and https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3C4D5E.

Karthik — please expect an access-ticket from Nexera for S3/API provisioning Monday morning; Marcus or whoever owns infra on the Nexera side will create the ticket. Daniel — we’ll use the MAP template I attached and I’ll populate the outcome metrics based on Marissa’s example and your inputs.

If anything changes to the attendee list, reply-all and we’ll adjust. Looking forward to the Sprint Zero kickoff.

Best,
Avery
